subject: Cloudmark — Handoff & Activation plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cloudmark — Handoff & Activation plan

David / Monica — quick handoff note for Cloudmark (closing today). High level:
- ACV: $425k (annual) — Reserved Dedicated capacity, Private VPC deployment.
- Contract: standard enterprise + addendum for data residency (US only) — DocuSign link below.
- Target go-live: 2029-01-18 (requested by customer; flexible +/- 1 week for staging).
- Key contacts: Sam Li (SRE lead) and Priya Sharma (Engineering PM) at cloudmark.ai.

Current blockers / asks for CS & Implementation:
1) Security review outstanding — Cloudmark requested network diagram + SOC2 evidence. I attached the SOW draft and a quick network diagram.
2) KMS/HSM: Cloudmark needs confirmation on customer-managed keys (they prefer HSM via AWS KMS): confirm integration path and any limitations.
3) Staging window: they asked for a 48h canary with 99th p99 latency monitoring; please propose how we want to run the canary.
4) SLA/Support: they requested a 1-hour priority channel during the go-live weekend — flag for ops if we need a temporary escalation channel.

Action: Monica, can you confirm ownership and send an initial 30/60/90 plan by EOD tomorrow? David, looping you to help with seat allocation and quota configuration for Dedicated pool.

Attachments: SOW_Cloudmark_Draft_v3.pdf (SOW draft), cloudmark_network_diagram.png (topology)
Links: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/CLOUD-3482

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cloudmark — Handoff & Activation plan

Thanks Marissa — congrats on the close.
Monica — I will assign seat/quota and schedule a short capacity prep with infra. Preliminary notes for the team:
- Dedicated pool sizing: 2x A100 equivalent reservations initially; likely to scale after week 2.
- Token quotas: allot 12M tokens/month for the first commit, with burst policy of +20% during rollout windows.
- Networking: review diagram and confirm whether Cloudmark will provide IP allowlist or expects our static egress IPs.

Monica — can you confirm you’ll own the onboarding and identify the primary implementation engineer? Also:
- Please request the customer SSO metadata (IdP metadata XML) and an initial list of KMS requirements.
- Recommend scheduling kickoff for the week of 2029-01-08; propose two 90-minute blocks for Tech Kickoff and Security Review.

I’ll put in a support seat reservation for the go-live weekend (pending Tessa OK).

-David
David Kim | Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Sam Li <sam@cloudmark.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@cloudmark.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 11:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cloudmark — Handoff & Activation plan

Hi all — I’ll take point as Implementation Owner. Thanks for the context Marissa.
Planned next steps (I'll own these and will update the shared worksheet):
1) Kickoff scheduling: propose Tech Kickoff on 2029-01-09 10:00-11:30 PT and Security Review on 2029-01-10 09:00-10:30 PT. Sam / Priya — are those windows workable?
2) Pre-kickoff asks for Cloudmark (please share ahead of the Tech Kickoff):
   - IdP metadata (SAML) for SSO setup
   - KMS/HSM requirements (key rotation policy, whether they want CMK in AWS KMS)
   - List of initial production IPs to allowlist (we will provide our egress IPs if needed)
   - A short list of 5 example production prompts for baseline QA (we'll use for quality regression checks)
3) Canary plan: we'll run a 48-hour canary in staging with two phases: (a) low-traffic smoke (10% traffic), (b) steady ramp to 50% with monitoring on p50/p95/p99, error rate, and token spending. If p99 exceeds target, automatic fallback to smaller model variant.
4) Documentation & artifacts I’ll provide: implementation-worksheet.xlsx (initial owner map & milestones), runbook template, rollback checklist.

Attachments: implementation-worksheet.xlsx (stub)

Notes for David: please provision the Dedicated pool and token quotas by 2028-12-08 so we can validate capacity in staging.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Li <sam@cloudmark.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@cloudmark.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 15:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cloudmark — Handoff & Activation plan

Monica — thanks, this looks good. Confirming a few things from Cloudmark side:
- Tech Kickoff: 2029-01-09 10:00 PT works for Sam (SRE) and Priya (PM).
- SRE contact: Arun Mehta (arun.mehta@cloudmark.ai) — he’ll join the kickoff.
- IdP metadata: will send SAML metadata (XML) and initial user mapping by EOD tomorrow.
- KMS: we confirm requirement for customer-managed CMK in AWS KMS; we will share key policy and rotation cadence.
- DocuSign: Sarah (legal) will counter-sign once we receive the DocuSign PowerForm; will expedite.
- IP allowlist: attached a first pass of production egress IP ranges (see inline — will follow up with a formal spreadsheet).

Inline: [docuSign link received — Sarah will complete signing flow]

We appreciate the canary approach — we prefer the fallback to a quantized smaller model only during the 48h staging window if p99 spikes.

Sam Li
SRE Lead | Cloudmark.ai
